decisions.reason: As a flagship, close-to-core product line with several models, it fits the firm’s strategic direction and likely still offers upside that outweighs its relatively low software carrying cost.

The education institute is adjacent to the core business and can deepen customer relationships, so despite higher ongoing effort than pure software it remains a useful option to support the installed base.
A remote support tool directly strengthens service delivery for existing software customers, and its complementarity to the core offer makes it worth retaining unless evidence turns clearly negative.
Practice analytics matches the firm’s move toward more digital and efficiently managed practices, so uncertainty about growth potential still favors keeping this option open.
A complete practice bundle is very close to the established offer and likely helps packaging and selling the core system, making it inexpensive and strategically sensible to continue.

The job and practice listing portal is the most distant from the firm’s established software business and, with many stronger adjacent options available, management is likely to reallocate resources away from it.
